description: A ClickStack MongoDB CASL permission condition is a plain value or a `$regex` match (oneOf a string and an inline object), and the object arm has no name in the spec, so the converter calls it ClickStackMongoDBCASLPermissionConditionsValueCase1. Name it for what it matches. Source: the OpenAPI document served at https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1 (2026-11-12).
